title: 破碎的真相
prompt: A close-up of [SUBJECT 1] holding a mirror shard to their face. The shard reflects a completely different [SUBJECT 2]. Around them, small cracks spread through the air like fractures in invisible glass, warping the space itself.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 创作超现实数字艺术，通过镜面碎片与扭曲空间，完美呈现破碎现实或双重身份，适合广告与平面设计中的概念叙事。
